articles.title: Vehicle strikes teen pedestrian, 2 parked cars in Scarborough

articles.title: Police search for urn stolen from Hamilton home undergoing repairs after a fire
articles.summary: Hamilton police are searching for an urn stolen from a home that had been undergoing repairs after a fire. Investigators say on August 21, a fire broke out at a home on Rosslyn Avenue which destroyed a neighbouring home. The neighbours were unable to stay in the home and were forced to relocate until repairs […]

articles.summary: Toronto police are investigating after the victim of a stabbing was found lying on the road in Scarborough. articles.title: Man suffers gunshot wound, Toronto police investigating possible shooting location
articles.summary: Toronto police are investigating where a shooting may have taken place after a man walked into a hospital with a gunshot wound. Police say the man walked into the hospital in the Finch Avenue and Arrow Road area just before 1 a.m. His injuries have been classified as non-life-threatening. articles.title: Police identify 2nd victim in separate vehicle fires within hours of each other in Etobicoke, Scarborough
articles.summary: Toronto police have identified a body that was found in a burning vehicle in Etobicoke last week shortly after another body was found in a burning vehicle in Scarborough.

articles.title: Man in his 60s dead after crash in Brampton: Peel police
articles.summary: A man in his 60s has died after a two-vehicle crash in Brampton on Sunday morning, Peel police said.

articles.title: 57-year-old man dead, 1 arrested after stabbing in North York: police
articles.summary: A 57-year-old man is dead after a stabbing in North York on Saturday night, Toronto police said.
